_comment: Every Effectory UX skill and where its folder lives. sync-skills.sh copies each into skills/<name>/ of the team plugin repo. `path` is a folder in that repo; `pending` marks a skill whose repo does not expose a skill folder yet.

skills.name: prototype-toolbar
skills.note: Fetches its own guide/adopt.sh/README from its repo at run time (toolbar-skill.sh sync), so this copy rarely needs re-syncing.

skills.name: effectory-design-system
skills.note: Fetches its reference, screens and DS files at run time (ds-skill.sh sync). Its bundle also carries design-system-files/ and reference-prototypes/ — large; sparse checkout keeps the clone small.

skills.name: ux-copy
skills.note: Private repo, static content: re-sync the team plugin when it changes.

skills.name: realistic-content
skills.note: Private repo. Its SKILL.md sits at the root next to build scripts and data, and the shipped bundle is built by build.sh into dist/realistic-content.skill. Ask its owner to expose a plain skills/realistic-content/ folder (or set `path` to it once it exists), then drop `pending`.
